mapper.sql: id, task_id, openlist_config_id, source_path, strm_path, source_file_name, media_type, tmdb_id, title, original_title, release_year, overview, poster_url, backdrop_url, vote_average, scrape_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_library_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM media_library_item
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM media_library_item
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_library_item ( task_id, openlist_config_id, source_path, strm_path, source_file_name, media_type, tmdb_id, title, original_title, release_year, overview, poster_url, backdrop_url, vote_average, scrape_status ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{openlistConfigId}, #{sourcePath}, #{strmPath}, #{sourceFileName}, #{mediaType}, #{tmdbId}, #{title}, #{originalTitle}, #{releaseYear}, #{overview}, #{posterUrl}, #{backdropUrl}, #{voteAverage}, #{scrapeStatus} ) ON CONFLICT(openlist_config_id, source_path) DO UPDATE SET task_id = excluded.task_id, strm_path = excluded.strm_path, source_file_name = excluded.source_file_name, media_type = excluded.media_type, tmdb_id = COALESCE(excluded.tmdb_id, media_library_item.tmdb_id), title = excluded.title, original_title = COALESCE(excluded.original_title, media_library_item.original_title), release_year = COALESCE(excluded.release_year, media_library_item.release_year), overview = COALESCE(excluded.overview, media_library_item.overview), poster_url = COALESCE(excluded.poster_url, media_library_item.poster_url), backdrop_url = COALESCE(excluded.backdrop_url, media_library_item.backdrop_url), vote_average = COALESCE(excluded.vote_average, media_library_item.vote_average), scrape_status = excluded.scrape_status, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE media_library_item SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openlist_config_id = #{openlistConfigId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE media_library_item SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openlist_config_id = #{openlistConfigId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
